budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Evacuate all five casualties through excavated caverns; sustain shared air and infrastructure while provisioning other crews.
task.natural_termination: Natural completion exactly when rescued == 5; otherwise truncate at 512. Health never falls below 1, so injured actors remain controllable.
task.interaction: Excavation opens native tiles and emits spreading dust. Duct pumping changes nearby air; beams prevent dust-triggered floor collapse. Carried casualties follow actors to depots; shared supplies and hauling routes change other actors' opportunities.
task.observation_access: Self fields and declared public counters/charts are exact. For each entity slot, visibility is active AND Chebyshev distance <= 3 from the role's current position; hidden slots have visible=0 and all values zero. Actor slots use the same radius. Patches cover dx,dy -3..3 in row-major order, outside=-1. Public static bounds, indexing and action meanings do not expose hidden current state. Legal masks are native affordance information; no renderer-only policy information. Human and policy actors use the same scalar action and transition.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Total casualties evacuated to any depot

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
